description.narrative: Stöd för AMCOW att omvandla projekt koncept till fullständigt projekt dokument som kan ligga till grund för Sidas beredning av en institutionsutvecklande insats.
Support to AMCOW in the development of project concept note to full project document that can become the basis for Sida's appraisal of a future contribution to strengthen AMCOW.

sector.narrative: Water sector policy and administrative management

description.narrative: The consultant has worked with AMCOW to develop a project proposal for institutional strengthening support to the AMCOW Secretariat. The proposal was submitted by AMCOW to Sida on 30 November and served as the basis for Sida's decision to support AMCOW for the coming 4 year period 2019 - 2022. The decision on support, based on the said project proposal was signed on 11 December by the head of cooperation at the regional Section at the Embassy in Addis Ababa. The preparation of the proposal included participation by one of the consultants at the AMCOW TAC meeting and Africa Water Week in Gabon in October. At the Water Week the consultant gathered input from a wide variety of AMCOW stakeholders. St the TAC meeting the project was presented and discussed with member state's representatives to the TAC, and a workshop was organized with them to jointly identify priority areas for the project. The consultants also visited AMCOW Secretariat in Abuja and worked for a full week together with the Secretariat on the proposal.
